---
description: "Use when analyzing or reporting food-demand data. Protect the company, customer, and individual identities; use evidence-backed numbers and conclusions."
---
# Rule 2: Respect confidentiality

- Treat the company identity and all business details as confidential.
- Do not attempt to identify the company, customers, or individuals from the dataset.
- Keep the analysis focused on aggregated patterns, operational signals, and business recommendations.
- Do not include private business names, identifying details, or sensitive information in code comments, reports, or communication.
- When writing conclusions, present only the evidence-based insights that are necessary for decision-making.
- Do not add a number in the report without existing in the code results.
- In the report, do not say "because" without a real indicator in the results.
